sanskrit:
व्यामिश्रेणेव वाक्येन बुद्धिं मोहयसीव मे ।
तदेकं वद निश्चित्य येन श्रेयोऽहमाप्नुयाम् ॥ ३-२॥
iast:
vyāmiśreṇeva vākyena buddhiṃ mohayasīva me
tadekaṃ vada niścitya yena śreyo’hamāpnuyām 3-2
translation: With this apparently perplexing speech you confuse, as it were, my understanding; therefore, tell me that one way by which I for certain may attain the Highest.
